brief_title: A Phase I Study to Evaluate the Food Effect on Ecnoglutide Tablet
official_title: A Randomized, Open-label, Multiple-dose, Multicenter Phase I Study to Evaluate the Food Effect on the Pharmacokinetics of Ecnoglutide Tablets in Chinese Adult Participants

primary_outcomes.measure: Area under the curve from time 0 to infinity
Area under the curve from time 0 to 24h
Area under the curve from time 0 to last quantifiable time point

brief_summary: The aim of the study is to evaluate food effect on pharmacokinetics of oral ecnoglutide tablets in Chinese participants

inclusion.text: Body mass index (BMI): 19.0 kg/m² ≤ BMI < 30.0 kg/m², with body weight ≥ 55 kg (male) or ≥ 50 kg (female);

Participants of childbearing potential agree to have no plans for pregnancy during the entire study period and within 6 months after the last dose: female participants must be non-pregnant and non-lactating, with no plans to donate ova, and male participants must have no plans to donate sperm; all participants voluntarily use effective contraception, with female participants avoiding pregnancy and male participants avoiding causing pregnancy in their partners;

exclusion.text: History of severe drug allergy (especially known or suspected allergy to any component of Ecnoglutide Tablets, regardless of the severity of previous allergic reactions), or severe atopic allergic disease/history (e.g., asthma, urticaria, eczematous dermatitis, etc.), or discretion by the investigator to have a severe allergic condition (e.g., allergy to two or more drugs/foods, or repeated allergic reactions requiring medical intervention);
Diagnosis of overweight or obesity of endocrine origin, such as Cushing's syndrome;
Diagnosis of diabetes mellitus of any type (excluding gestational diabetes mellitus);
History of acute or chronic pancreatitis, pancreatic injury, symptomatic biliary disease, or other high-risk factors that may lead to pancreatitis;

Diagnosis of other endocrine diseases of significant clinical significance, including but not limited to hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism, thyroid nodules (imaging showing C-TIRADS ≥ 4A), thyroid cancer, or a personal or family history of multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 (MEN2);

Occurrence of severe gastrointestinal diseases, including but not limited to inflammatory bowel disease, active ulcers, severe irritable bowel syndrome, celiac disease, recurrent dyspepsia, or clinically abnormal gastric emptying (e.g., pyloric obstruction), within 6 months prior to screening; or presence of gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or constipation at screening/before the first dose;

Occurrence of severe hypoglycemia or recurrent symptomatic hypoglycemia (≥ 2 episodes within 6 months) (e.g., anxiety, dizziness, sweating, tremor, hunger, and poor concentration, etc.), within 6 months prior to screening;
Diagnosis of malignant tumor within 5 years, except for cured basal cell carcinoma of the skin, cervical carcinoma in situ, etc., as discreted by the investigator to be clinically insignificant;
History of depression, or other severe psychiatric illness, or suicidal ideation or suicidal behavior;

Within 3 months prior to screening, participation in and use of any investigational drug, vaccine, special medical food, or invasive device clinical trial, or planned participation in other clinical trials during the study period;
